intro: These words come from Amerikanski Srbobran, a Serbian newspaper printed in Pittsburgh in Cyrillic letters, on pages from 1906 to 1963. Some Latin letters print the same as Cyrillic ones (C and С, P and Р), so they count as the same and are never highlighted.
name: Serbian

notes.Ђ: the right leg curls into a hook at the bottom; Ћ's leg is straight
notes.Ј: an upright that hooks to the left at the bottom, with no dot
notes.Љ: Л joined to a bowl on the right; Њ is Н joined to one

notes.и: the middle stroke slants up to the right; н has a level bar

notes.ц: a small tail at the bottom right; џ's tail is in the middle
